title: imap/session/mod: capability_list uses Vec1::unvalidated
description: crates/imap/src/session/commands.rs capability_list() line 35 — uses Vec1::unvalidated(caps) to bypass the 'at least one element' invariant check. The comment says 'Safety: always at least one element' but Vec1 provides a try_from or from_ne_slice API that validates at construction time and panics with a clear message. Using unvalidated bypasses a library invariant for no performance gain.
